description: 10 On Your Side asked every candidate in this race the same four questions: why we’re running, what qualifies us, whether campaign contributions influence our votes, and how we’d tackle the national debt. I answered each one plainly. I explain why an independent can say what party nominees can’t, and what 28 years of command and a decade of engineering power grids taught me about accountability. I also explain why this campaign takes no PAC money, and what honest, on-time budgets would look like
